LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Asar.]
(OBS :) Chronic sciatica.
Dull pressure in right hip.
Drawing tensive pain in head of left femur.
Severe pain in hip joint and middle of thigh when stepping ; the foot feels as if paralyzed, he cannot step properly thereon.
Severe rheumatic tearing stitches in knees, during motion and at rest.
Lassitude in knees.
Drawing in hamstrings when lying in bed ; in knee.
Gurgling sensation in patella.
Bruised feeling in left tibia.
Stitches in ankles and soles.
The little toes pain as if frozen.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Asar.]
Lightness of all limbs ; he does not perceive that he has a body.
Occasional darting and tearing pains in upper and lower limbs.
Rheumatism < in dry, cold weather.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Asar.]
Sitting : confusion of head < ; pain in head > ; pain in small of back ; headache ; nausea and weakness <.
Lying : headache > ; drawing in knees and hamstrings ; weakness and nausea > ; heat of face and palms.
Rest : stitch in shoulders ; stitches in knees.
Motion : stitch in shoulders ; stitches in knees.
Walking : confusion of head > ; headache <.
Shaking head ; headache <.
Moving head : pain in cervical muscles.
Stooping : pain in forehead.
   

NERVES. [36] [Asar.]
Excessive sensibility of all nerves. See 24.
Great nervous irritation.
Hysteria.
Excessive sensibility of all the nerves when merely thinking (and this he must continually) that some one might with the finger tip or nail scratch even lightly on linen or similar material ; a most disagreeable sensation thrills through him, arresting momentarily all his thoughts and actions.
Great lassitude.
Great faintness and constant yawning.
General weary feeling.
So weak and nauseated towards evening, that when he rises to sitting posture he feels as if he would instantly sink down and die ; he must lie in bed.
So weak he staggers, unless his mind is on his walking.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Asar.]
Evening in bed, agitation in blood, prevents sleep for two hours.
After lying down in evening, sweat.
Condition of mind as if just falling asleep ; gradual vanishing of ideas.
Frequent yawning.
Great drowsiness by day.
Restless sleep.
Short breath at night.
Nightly vexatious dreams about humiliations.
   

TIME. [38] [Asar.]
Morning : dizziness and drowsiness ; headache on rising ; eyes < ; hunger ; horrible sensation in epigastrium on awaking ; stiff neck.
Forenoon : chilly, cold feeling <.
Midday : eyes >.
During day : drowsiness.
At 5 P. M. : pain in head <.
Towards evening : weakness and nausea <.
Evening : eyes < ; heat of face and palms ; cutaneous diseases < ; sweat.
Night : shortness of breathing.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Asar.]
Dry, cold weather : rheumatism <.
Open air : headache > ; chilly, cold feeling worse.
In heat, sunlight and wind : eyes worse.
Cold water : eyes better.
Cold air : eyes > ; ears worse.
Hottest weather : cold hands, feet, abdomen or knees, not better.
Covering, or warm room : cold feeling no better.
Washing : pain in head better.
Damp weather : symptoms improve.
   

FEVER. [40] [Asar.]
Chills during day, without thirst.
Nervous chilliness, single parts icy cold. θ Chorea season.
Cold hands, feet, knees or abdomen ; even hottest weather does not relieve ; timid, nervous persons.
Chill and cold feeling in forenoon, after eating or drinking, and in open air, generally with heat of head.
Great want of vital heat ; feels cold continually.
Cold feeling, not relieved by covering, or warmth of room.
Heat in evening, after lying down, particularly in face and palms of hands.
Alternate flushes of burning heat and coldness.
Sweat increased at night, of sour smell ; most profuse in axillæ.
Sweats easily, particularly on upper part of body.
Slow fevers, no reaction from spinal enervation.
Typhus.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Asar.]
Right : pressure below eyelid ; singing in ear ; sensation of skin stretched over external ear ; pressure within ear ; stinging in cheek ; stitches in lungs ; burning in chest ; pain border of scapula ; pressure in hip.
Left : side of forehead and temple ache ; coldness side of head ; pressure in eye ; upper eyelid swollen ; roaring in ear ; ear deaf : nostril stopped ; stinging pain in cheek ; teeth feel hollow ; pain side of abdomen ; pain in groin ; pain head of femur ; bruised feeling in tibia.
Above downward : pressure in forehead ; cutting in abdomen.
Within outward : pressure in eyes.
Without inward : pressure over brain.
Before backward : pain in abdomen.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Asar.]
As if temple would be drawn in ; teeth as if loose ; as if without a head ; foot feels as if paralyzed ; as if he would sink down and die ; lightness in limbs, as if gliding through air ; as if a skin was stretched over right ear ; as if ears were plugged ; as if pressed asunder in eyes ; as if constricted by a thin wire both lungs ; as from a tight cravat in muscles of neck ; as if frozen in little toe ; horrible sensation at epigastrium.
Cutting : articulation of lower jaw ; bellyache ; in upper abdomen ; in rectum.
Violent pain : in left groin darting through urethra to glans ; in small of back.
Tearing pulsating pain in forehead.
Tearing : in left temple ; from crest of one ilium to the other ; in knees ; through limbs.
Darting : through urethra ; through limbs.
Dull stitches : in lungs ; under scapulæ.
Fine stitches : below left temple.
Stitches : in throat ; in rectum ; in larynx ; in small of back ; in shoulders ; in knees ; in ankles ; in soles.
Stinging : in canthi ; or right cheek ; and burning in left cheek.
Burning : of eyes ; across tongue ; in right chest ; in small of back.
Biting : on tongue.
Smarting : in gums ; in glans penis.
Pinching : in left side of abdomen to back.
Compressive pain : in left temple ; behind ears.
Drawing : in temple ; in left wrist ; through thumb to index finger ; in head of left femur ; in hamstrings.
Sore pain : along inner border of right scapula.
Scraping : in throat.
Aching : in forehead ; in temples ; above root of nose ; in spleen.
Rheumatic pain : in knees.
Bruised pain : in cervical muscles ; in back ; in left tibia.
Sharp pain : over left eye.
Laming pain : in cervical muscles.
Pressure : in left eye ; in eyes as with a dull point from within outward ; in forehead upon the eyes ; above root of nose ; over brain ; in pit of stomach and abdomen ; in rectum ; on bladder ; in region of last ribs ; in right hip.
Throbbing : headache.
Jerking : in eyes.
Cramp : at articulation of lower jaw.
Contractive pain : in forehead, temples, and behind ears ; in glans penis ; in deltoid muscle.
Constriction : in region of diaphragm ; in larynx.
Tension : of scalp ; in orifice of meatus.
Tensive pressure : in ear.
Undefined pain : in eyes ; on sides of head ; in region of descending colon ; in small of back ; in sides ; in abdomen.
Gurgling : in patella.
Paralyzed feeling : in foot.
Oppression : around navel.
Coldness : above left ear ; in upper incisors.
Itching : below left temple.
Tickling : in nose.
Dryness : in eye ; in throat ; inner side of lower lip.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Asar.]
Irritability of the nerves.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Asar.]
Touch : auricle hot.
After operation on the eye : jerking pain.
   

SKIN. [46] [Asar.]
Skin
Discharge of bloody and slimy matter from ulcers.
Jaundice.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Asar.]
Plethoric young woman suffered for years from headaches.
Nervous temperament, excitable or melancholic mood.
Nervous, anxious people. θ During cholera season.
Drunkards ; popular in Russia.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Asar.]
Antidotes to Asar. : Camphor, vinegar, vegetable acids.
Followed by : Bismuth.
Compare : Acon., Aloes (stringy stools) ; Camphor (cholerine) ; Cuprum, Hepar, Ipec. (cholerine) ; Mercur. (stringy stools) ; Nux vom., Phosphor., Podoph. (stringy stools) ; Pulsat. (stringy stools) ; Sepia, Stramon., Sulph. ac. (stringy stools) ; Tabac. (cholerine) ; Veratr. (cholerine).
